title: Mario Golf: Super Rush
subtitle: A golf shot followed by a race
summary: Mario Golf: Super Rush is Camelot's Switch golf game, released on 25 June 2021.
body: Mario Golf: Super Rush is Camelot's Switch golf game, released on 25 June 2021. Familiar Mario characters play traditional rounds alongside modes that turn the trip between shots into part of the competition. In Speed Golf, players hit the ball and then run after it, trying to complete a course quickly while navigating obstacles and rivals. The careful preparation of a stroke meets a much less orderly journey across the fairway, making the space between the tee and the next lie part of the action.

Standard golf remains centered on finishing each hole in as few strokes as possible. A shot gauge and scanning tools help assess direction, slope and elevation before choosing a club and swing. Button controls are joined by an option to imitate the swing through motion controls. Special Shots add character-specific effects that can disturb another player's plan. The player can choose how much of that extra interference belongs in a match, keeping the underlying course-reading task visible beneath the more theatrical abilities.

Speed Golf combines the time taken to run with the consequences of each shot, so a long strike also determines the route the character must travel next. Battle Golf condenses the contest into an arena where players race to finish three holes. A separate adventure follows a Mii through golf challenges and development. Motoi Sakuraba's score accompanies the different formats. Super Rush uses the same ball-and-course foundation for both a measured sporting round and a race in which reaching the next shot becomes a challenge of its own.
